system.description:
Spectral Interrogation (OPDC): whoever leads the session rolls their Strange Pool, and each other player taking part may add 1 Skill Die as an assist. Each Strange symbol lets you ask a spirit one question, which it answers. When the ritual ends the Doom Clock moves forward 5 minutes.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.159
system.summary: Spectral Interrogation (OPDC): whoever leads the session rolls their Strange Pool, and each other player taking part may add 1 Skill Die as an assist. Each Strange symbol lets you ask a spirit one question, which it answers. When the ritual ends the Doom Clock moves forward 5 minutes.

automation.label: Spectral Interrogation
automation.onSuccess: Ask the spirits one question for each Strange symbol rolled.
automation.onFail: No Strange symbols: the spirits answer nothing.

automation.note: The leader uses the board and adds 1 Skill Die to the roll for each other player taking part. Each Strange symbol is one question the spirits must answer. The 5 Doom minutes are added when the board is used.
